flows.title: Find a drill and coach it
flows.summary: The library helps a coach find and save an idea, then opens a focused board with the drill's coaching notes.

steps.action: searches or filters the visual library
steps.detail: Search matches titles, descriptions, and tags. All-topic filtering and name/recent sorting work in the library and saved-drill views.

steps.action: renders starting setups from drill JSON
steps.detail: BoardSvg draws each preview. Cards show player count, step count, and animation length; demo seconds are not practice duration.

steps.action: bookmarks an idea or opens its board
steps.detail: Bookmarks save drill IDs in this browser when storage is available. Opening another drill uses the existing persistence flow.

steps.action: shows coach notes beside the tactics board
steps.detail: Edit details opens the inspector; selecting a piece reveals its controls. The grouped tool palette and sequence strip edit the existing drill model.

steps.action: returns to the library
steps.detail: Playback pauses. Board shortcuts stay inactive until the board is open again.

flows.title: The edit loop
flows.summary: A drag on the board becomes a saved file in about a second — and the file watcher's echo of that save is recognized and ignored.

steps.action: drags a player on the SVG board
steps.detail: useBoardInteraction starts a gesture: history pauses so the whole drag is one undo entry.

steps.action: drill state updates per pointer move
steps.detail: moveEntity writes the pose into the current step; endGesture replays the drag as a single tracked change.

steps.action: autosave fires after an 800ms quiet period
steps.detail: serializeDense materializes forward-fill, rounds to cm, and PUTs with If-Match: rev.

steps.action: atomic write, rev+1
steps.detail: tmp file + rename so readers never see a half-written drill; rev/updatedAt stamped.

steps.action: chokidar sees the change → SSE
steps.detail: The app recognizes its own write via a consume-once expected-rev token and skips reloading itself.

flows.title: The agent route
flows.summary: The coach gives an agent a drill request, directly or by copying a prepared brief. The agent writes and validates JSON; the running library refreshes from disk.

steps.action: fills out Describe a drill
steps.detail: Type or use device dictation for the coaching objective, then add ages, players, space, time, and an optional progression. The draft stays in this browser when storage is available.

steps.action: prepares a readable prompt for review and copying
steps.detail: Clipboard success is shown; if clipboard access fails, the text is selected for manual copying. There is no model or speech backend.

steps.action: pastes the brief into a Codex task opened in this repository
steps.detail: This is a manual handoff. The coach may also ask Claude Code or Codex directly without using the form.

steps.action: reads AGENTS.md and drill-authoring.md, then writes drills/<slug>.json
steps.detail: The brief requests setup, named movement steps, coaching points, variations, and validation with npm run validate -- drills/<file>.json.

steps.action: SSE drills-changed within ~1s
steps.detail: awaitWriteFinish debounces partial writes.

steps.action: library refreshes; open drill reloads or conflicts
steps.detail: Not the open drill → card appears. Open and clean → silent reload preserving cursor. Open and dirty → conflict dialog: use disk vs keep mine.

steps.action: parseDrill forgives and normalizes
steps.detail: Duplicate ids keep-first, unknown position keys dropped, sparse steps densified so editing behaves identically either way.

flows.title: The export pipeline
flows.summary: One deterministic frame loop feeds every visual format; the server lays out a ready-to-post bundle for the team site's agent.

steps.action: sceneAt(t) → BoardSvg markup → canvas, at a fixed timestep
steps.detail: The exact component the editor shows, rasterized frame by frame; abortable; even dimensions for H.264.

steps.action: WebCodecs H.264 → mediabunny MP4 (VP9/WebM fallback); gifenc GIF; PNG snapshot
steps.detail: Hardware encode runs faster than realtime; GIF defaults stay modest (720px/12fps) with a size warning past 20s.

steps.action: streams blobs to exports/<drill>/
steps.detail: Streaming + tmp/rename: no RAM spike on long narrations, no partial files.

steps.action: poster + GIF + MP4 + drill JSON + manifest-snippet.json + AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md
steps.detail: The snippet matches the soccer-quizzes manifest shape; the instructions tell the site agent exactly where each file goes.

steps.action: Region-Capture tab recording + mic via MediaRecorder
steps.detail: Live capture, deliberately: the coach's voice and cursor over real playback. Countdown stays out of the take; failed uploads fall back to a browser download.
